newsitem.title: FINLAND: Benefon gets type approval for GSM handset.
newsitem.headline: Benefon gets type approval for GSM handset.

text.p: Finnish mobile phone maker Benefon Oy said in a statement on Monday it had received type approval for its first GSM (Global System for Mobile Communications) handset, the Benefon Gamma.
"The company can now take action to start production and marketing of the product," Benefon said.
GSM-systems are in use in over 100 countries and it is expected that over 20 million GSM-phones will be sold worldwide this year, Benefon said.
In addition to digital phones, Benefon would continue work on its analogue handsets, especially NMT 450 products, it said. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
